name: Agent Factory Solution Pack
description: A governed, reusable delivery package for designing, testing, deploying, monitoring, and packaging custom AI agents with workflows.
business_outcome: Turn an authorized agent opportunity into a controlled, testable implementation package whose capabilities, authority, evidence, deployment conditions, and operating responsibilities are explicit.
implementation_model: A gated engagement spanning authorization, architecture, instructions and knowledge, workflows and tools, evaluation, controlled deployment planning, monitoring, and optional marketplace packaging.
success_measures: agent mission and authority are unambiguous
knowledge and tool behavior are traceable
deployment has approval and rollback gates
monitoring detects quality, safety, cost, and drift issues
support_model: AI AuthoriTech maintains the governed build package and offers separately authorized implementation, platform adaptation, monitoring, optimization, and release support.
